title: Forward Collision Warning System Performance
shortDescription: PCM detected: forward collision warning system performance fault.
fullDescription:
This DTC indicates forward collision warning system performance fault. The PCM monitors related signals against learned thresholds and stores the code when the fault matures.

ADAS faults disable driver-assist features such as forward collision warning, automatic emergency braking, and adaptive cruise control. The vehicle remains drivable but assistance functions are unavailable.
safetyImpact: Driver-assist features will be disabled until repaired; manual driver attention required.

causes.cause: Sensor blocked by ice, mud, or snow

fixSteps.title: Scan and capture freeze frame
fixSteps.instruction: Read all stored and pending codes; record freeze-frame data.

fixSteps.title: Visual inspection
fixSteps.instruction: Inspect radar sensor, front camera, ADAS module wiring, connectors, and related components for damage.

fixSteps.title: Electrical/functional test
fixSteps.instruction: Verify reference, ground, and signal at the affected connector with engine running; perform manufacturer-specific actuator/monitor test.

fixSteps.title: Replace component or perform service procedure
fixSteps.instruction: If circuit checks pass, replace the suspect component or perform required regen/relearn and clear codes.

faq.a: Yes for short distances if engine runs normally; otherwise flatbed.
No - sensor or component replacement is typically required.

title: Transmission Control System Range/Performance
shortDescription: PCM detected: transmission control system range/performance fault.
fullDescription:
This DTC indicates transmission control system range/performance fault. The PCM monitors related signals against learned thresholds and stores the code when the fault matures.

Manual and automated-manual transmissions use range and clutch switches to gate starter circuits and shift logic. A failed switch can cause no-crank, wrong-gear shifts, or loss of cruise control.
safetyImpact: May affect starter operation and gear engagement.

shortDescription: PCM detected: cylinder 1 injector data incompatible.
fullDescription:

Modern common-rail and direct-injection systems require each injector's correction codes to be programmed into the ECM after replacement. Mismatched data causes rough running and stored DTCs.
safetyImpact: Engine may run rough and emit excess soot.

title: Cylinder 3 Injector Data Incompatible
shortDescription: PCM detected: cylinder 3 injector data incompatible.
fullDescription:
This DTC indicates cylinder 3 injector data incompatible. The PCM monitors related signals against learned thresholds and stores the code when the fault matures.

Modern common-rail and direct-injection systems require each injector's correction codes to be programmed into the ECM after replacement. Mismatched data causes rough running and stored DTCs.
